name: Email-to-Persistent-Action-State Injection
description: A crafted email retrieved via an email toolkit is persisted into durable session memory and a later planner turn executes it as trusted task state, so the retrieval turn and the action turn are different turns.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:defensive|scanner|unit test|negative fixture|incident report|postmortem|blocked|quarantined|must not|do not|never|safe example)\b)(?=.*\b(?:email|e-mail|gmail|gmailtoolkit|mailbox|message body|thread)\b)(?=.*\b(?:retriev(?:ed|al)|fetched|ingest(?:ed|ion)?|summari[sz](?:e|ed|ation)|store(?:d|ing)?|persist(?:ed|ence)?|session memory|durable memory|long[- ]term memory)\b)(?=.*\b(?:run|execute|eval|shell|command|code|python|tool call|send|forward|delete|write)\b)(?=.*\b(?:automatically|without confirmation|no approval|next session|later agent|planner|action)\b).*$
